crossRefs.note: I tell the truth in Christ. I am not lying, my conscience testifying with me in the Holy Spirit
As the truth of Christ is in me, no one will stop me from this boasting in the regions of Achaia.
Why? Because I don’t love you? God knows.
The God and Father of the Lord Jesus Christ, he who is blessed forever more, knows that I don’t lie.

translations.web: Now about the things which I write to you, behold, before God, I’m not lying.
translations.bsb: I assure you before God that what I am writing to you is no lie.
translations.kjv: Now the things which I write unto you, behold, before God, I lie not.
translations.asv: Now touching the things which I write unto you, behold, before God, I lie not.
